verses.original: לְדָוִ֨ד׀ אוֹדְךָ֥ בְכָל־ לִבִּ֑י נֶ֖גֶד אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲזַמְּרֶֽךָּ׃
verses.literal: Of David I give You thanks with all my heart before the gods I sing Your praises
verses.literalPt: Graças te darei de todo o meu coração; diante dos deuses, a ti cantarei louvores.

verses.original: אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֨ה אֶל־ הֵיכַ֪ל קָדְשְׁךָ֡ וְא֘וֹדֶ֤ה אֶת־ שְׁמֶ֗ךָ עַל־ חַסְדְּךָ֥ וְעַל־ אֲמִתֶּ֑ךָ כִּֽי־ הִגְדַּ֥לְתָּ עַל־ כָּל־ שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ אִמְרָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’eš·ta·ḥă·weh ’el- hê·ḵal qāḏ·šə·ḵā wə·’ō·w·ḏeh ’eṯ- šə·me·ḵā ‘al- ḥas·də·ḵā wə·‘al- ’ă·mit·te·ḵā kî- hiḡ·dal·tā ‘al- kā·lō·ši- šim·k̲ā ’im·rā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: I bow down toward Your holy temple and give thanks to Your name for Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness You have exalted Your name and Your word above all else
verses.literalPt: Prostrar-me-ei diante do teu santo templo e darei graças ao teu nome pela tua benignidade e pela tua verdade; pois, acima de todo o teu nome, tens magnificado a tua palavra.

verses.original: בְּי֣וֹם קָ֭רָֽאתִי וַֽתַּעֲנֵ֑נִי תַּרְהִבֵ֖נִי בְנַפְשִׁ֣י עֹֽז׃
verses.literal: On the day I called You answered me You emboldened me and strengthened my soul
verses.literalPt: No dia em que clamei, respondeste-me, alentaste-me com fortaleza na minha alma.

verses.original: יוֹד֣וּךָ יְ֭הוָה כָּל־ מַלְכֵי־ אָ֑רֶץ כִּ֥י שָׁ֝מְע֗וּ אִמְרֵי־ פִֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: yō·w·ḏū·ḵā Yah·weh kāl- mal·ḵê- ’ā·reṣ kî šā·mə·ʿû ’im·rê- p̄î·ḵā
verses.literal: All the kings of the earth will give You thanks O LORD when they hear the words of Your mouth
verses.literalPt: Todos os reis da terra te darão graças, ó Jeová, porque têm ouvido as palavras da tua boca.

verses.original: וְ֭יָשִׁירוּ בְּדַרְכֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֥י גָ֝ד֗וֹל כְּב֣וֹד יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·šî·rū bə·ḏar·ḵê Yah·weh kî ḡā·ḏō·wl kə·ḇō·wḏ Yah·weh
verses.literal: They will sing of the ways of the LORD for the glory of the LORD is great
verses.literalPt: Eles cantarão os caminhos de Jeová, pois grande é a glória de Jeová.

verses.original: כִּי־ רָ֣ם יְ֭הוָה וְשָׁפָ֣ל יִרְאֶ֑ה וְ֝גָבֹ֗הַּ מִמֶּרְחָ֥ק יְיֵדָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: kî- rām Yah·weh wə·šā·p̄āl yir·’eh wə·ḡā·ḇō·ah mim·mer·ḥāq yə·yê·ḏā‘
verses.literal: Though the LORD is on high He attends to the lowly but the proud He knows from afar
verses.literalPt: Embora Jeová seja excelso, contudo, olha para os humildes; mas os altivos, de longe, os conhece ele.

verses.original: אִם־ אֵלֵ֤ךְ׀ בְּקֶ֥רֶב צָרָ֗ה תְּחַ֫יֵּ֥נִי עַ֤ל אַ֣ף אֹ֭יְבַי תִּשְׁלַ֣ח יָדֶ֑ךָ וְת֖וֹשִׁיעֵ֣נִי יְמִינֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ’ê·lêḵ bə·qe·reḇ ṣā·rāh tə·ḥay·yê·nî ‘al ’ap̄ ’ō·yə·ḇay tiš·laḥ yā·ḏe·ḵā wə·ṯō·wō·šî·‘ê·nî yə·mî·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: If I walk in the midst of trouble You preserve me from the anger of my foes You extend Your hand and Your right hand saves me
verses.literalPt: Se eu andar no meio da tribulação, tu me vivificarás; contra a ira dos meus inimigos, estenderás a tua mão, e a tua destra me salvará.

verses.original: יְהוָה֮ יִגְמֹ֪ר בַּ֫עֲדִ֥י יְ֭הוָה חַסְדְּךָ֣ לְעוֹלָ֑ם מַעֲשֵׂ֖י יָדֶ֣יךָ אַל־ תֶּֽרֶף׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh yiḡ·mōr ba·‘ă·ḏî Yah·weh ḥas·də·ḵā lə·‘ō·w·lām ma·‘ă·śê yā·ḏe·ḵā ’al- te·rep̄
verses.literal: The LORD will fulfill His purpose for me O LORD Your loving devotion endures forever do not abandon the works of Your hands
verses.literalPt: Jeová aperfeiçoará o que me diz respeito a mim; a tua benignidade, Jeová, dura para sempre. Não abandones as obras das tuas mãos.
